summary_md: **AIVENTYX ([@Qaisermehdii](https://x.com/Qaisermehdii/status/2116210497964146710))** benchmarks a 7B model on vLLM: at equal load an RTX 3090 is cheaper ($0.082 vs $0.106 per 1M tokens at 64 concurrent), but at equal 6–7 s latency an A100 is about 4.6× cheaper ([data](https://github.com/qaisermehdi3-coder/qvunex/tree/main/benchmarks/data/planb-a100-2026-10-29)).
relevance: Cost/latency tradeoff data for local serving.
